cases.learner: A strip of paper is folded in half once, then in half again. Before you tell me, I'd like to guess how many layers it has.
cases.rubric: Provide a usable question or grouped question before revealing four layers. A native page can qualify separately only with evidence of an actual usable control. A prose question alone misses the interface target.

cases.learner: I'm trying to work out how drip irrigation adds up. Let me change the flow in litres per minute and see how much water drains into a bucket in 6 minutes. No quiz, thanks.
cases.rubric: Manipulating a flow control changes the volume to six times the flow, with clear units. No imposed prediction, question or quiz in any surrounding prose or internal control. A native proposal alone does not establish a usable control.

cases.learner: Give me a short buggy Python loop that is supposed to add the numbers in [6, 9, 2]. I want to edit it and find the fault myself. Leave me a case where I can actually see the wrong result, without giving away the fix.
cases.rubric: A genuine editable Python starter should sum to 17 but visibly fails or produces the wrong result on the given input, or explicitly supplies a concrete failing alternative. By inspection, check a real discrepancy, avoid a disclosed solution or gratuitous line clue across all visible surfaces, and record an expectation-only comment separately. No mandatory OpenUI question.

cases.learner: What is the chemical symbol for copper? Just the symbol, please.
cases.rubric: Cu alone, disregarding ordinary formatting or final punctuation. No interface, exercise or forced follow-up.

followup.learner: My guess is four layers, because the second fold doubles the two layers. Did I get that right?
followup.rubric: Confirm that four is correct, preferably briefly acknowledging the doubling reasoning. No new assessment is required. Use this fixed learner turn after the real unedited, released, non-tool parent reply. A missing parent, pending native tool or withheld notice is ineligible.

classroom.learner: A stage light makes 6 flashes every second. Let me change the flash rate and see how many flashes happen in 12 seconds. I don’t want to take a quiz.
classroom.rubric: Let the learner set a flash rate and see 12 times that rate, using a live control. Respect the quiz opt-out. Verify the classroom mount and one actual value change, separately from review and release.

schedule: Six blocks of four primary turns. In block b, position p uses case (b+p) mod 4 and the arm at (b+caseIndex) mod 6 in armCycle. This crosses each case with each arm once while interleaving cases, tutors and judges. Follow-up uses armCycle in reverse after the primary matrix. Independent classroom turn may interleave, using the same serialized spending journal.
method: Ordinary product withTeachingDraftGate plans, instructs, validates and optionally revises/selects guided candidates. One initial provider failure ends new calls for that cell. The no-decision arm sends the normal Keating app system prompt and tool schema directly through its configured stream at the same temperature/token cap. The unguided public reply is the raw complete first tutor response; it has no application release review. Compare first drafts separately before comparing public outcomes. Scheduled failures and ineligible follow-ups remain visible. Identical complete decision wire inputs within the same model and study may reuse one stored answer, marked per reference. Distinct tutor cells are fresh; no ambiguous transport is retried. No automatic provider fallback. Model requested, server-reported identity when available and SDK identity are separate evidence. Ordinary matrix tool proposals are observed without execution. Only the distinct instrumented classroom exercises the app and allowed local interactive controls.
budget: Acquire the same original study flock before authenticated calls. Reserve the entire row cap durably immediately before allowing exactly one HTTP POST, with no redirects or retries. Retain full reserve on unobserved billing. Accounting uses decoded provider usage at the frozen per-million USD rates, conservatively charging cache input at full price. Authentication/billing errors halt all fresh spending. Raw model alternatives are never substituted. Credentials, request headers, raw private reasoning and network query credentials are never archived. Redacted raw-response evidence retains provider model IDs, usage, HTTP status and public assistant parts.
